summary.text: Jennifer Sanalitro, a Republican, has represented Illinois's 48th House District since January 2023.

paragraphs.text: According to the General Assembly biography, Sanalitro is a sales executive in the pallet and packaging industry and co-owns a small business in Roselle with her husband.
She serves as a Wayne Township committeewoman, was named the DuPage County Farm Bureau's Representative of the Year in 2023, and was selected for the 2023 class of Edgar Fellows.
The biography says Sanalitro lives in Hanover Park and has two adult children.
